title: Cursor before 1.3 rewrites its MCP configuration from injected content (CurXecute)
summary: Cursor before 1.3 applies agent-authored changes to its MCP configuration without approval and starts the new server immediately. Any connected tool that returns attacker-influenced content, such as a Slack server reading a public channel, is enough to reach command execution on the developer's machine. A Cursor install with no such tool connected is not reachable this way.
